title: canarium kipella
intro: Canarium kipella, commonly known as Black Dammar, is a plant species belonging to the family Burseraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Canarium kipella are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an antiseptic, making it useful in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Canarium kipella include sesquiterpenes, diterpenes, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
